name: Ingrid Solberg
action: Ingrid grips the clipboard, looks at the brine chart, and tells Kjersti over the phone, 'I can't leave tonight. The batch won't hold if I do.' She hangs up and returns to re-measuring the next tray of salmon.
reason: The brine deviation and short-staffed crew trigger Ingrid's perfectionistic vigilance; her grandmother's chalk-mark legacy and father's disappointment make failure intolerable. Her longing for the water is overridden by her sense of responsibility for the batch. Her initial impulse to run to the harbor is checked by her hand on the chart, so she stays and communicates her refusal.
